Summary / Title: Filter switching causes screen flicker and incorrect challenge display
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
1. Click the "All" button at the top of the section.
2. Verify both Video and Quiz-only challenges are visible in the grid.
Expected Result: When switching between Video Challenges and Quiz Challenges filters, the content should update immediately without any screen flickering, and the filtered challenges should be displayed correctly
Actual Result: The screen flickers for a few seconds when clicking on Video Challenges or Quiz Challenges before the filtered content is displayed.

Summary / Title: Panda Logo does not redirect to top of page after scrolling
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
1. Scroll down on the homepage.
2. Click on the Panda Logo.
Expected Result: When the Panda Logo is clicked, the page should automatically scroll back to the top (front page).
Actual Result: When the Panda Logo is clicked after scrolling, the page does not return to the top/front page.

Summary / Title: Unable to delete Flashcards – Error message related to published video appears
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in to KFQ.
2. Navigate to Flashcards section.
3. Click on Delete for any existing Flashcard.
4. Confirm by clicking “Yes” on the confirmation popup (“Are you sure you want to delete the challenge?”).
Expected Result: The selected Flashcard should be deleted successfully after confirmation.
Actual Result: After confirming deletion, an error message appears stating: “Video is already published, cannot update annotation,” and the Flashcard is not deleted.

Summary / Title: User appears on Leaderboard despite leaving quiz before starting
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
Join a Quiz.
Leave/exit the quiz before clicking “Start” or before answering any questions.
Complete the quiz session from another account or wait until the quiz ends.
Check the final Leaderboard.
Expected Result: Users who leave the quiz before starting or attempting any questions should not appear on the final Leaderboard.
Actual Result: The user’s name is displayed on the final Leaderboard even though they exited the quiz before starting.

Summary / Title: Quiz completion message displayed even when user does not attempt any questions
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
Enter/Join a Quiz.

Do not click “Start” or do not answer any questions.

Wait until the timer runs out.
Expected Result: If the user does not attempt or start the quiz, the system should not display a “successfully completed” message. Instead, it should indicate that the quiz was not attempted or was left unanswered.
Actual Result: When the timer ends, the system displays a message such as “You have successfully completed the quiz…” even though no questions were attempted.
